name: tracking-event-qa
description: Configure and verify product analytics tracking events across every channel a plan routes them to, with Notion write-back and optional Jira follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Verify QA analytics events with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Configure squad and product profiles, resolve which channels each tracking event must reach, prove every QA-marked cell against observed traffic on each channel, check property values across platforms, and preview scoped Notion write-back with optional Jira follow-up.
defaultPrompt: Set up tracking QA for a squad and product.
Verify all tracking events currently marked QA.
Check whether any event is reaching a channel it was excluded from.
Show the failed tracking events and their evidence.
